request: Every paragraph typed in bold capitals should be Heading 1, and look exactly like it
summary: The paragraphs whose words are bold and all capitals get the Heading 1 paragraph style and lose their own direct formatting, so they look exactly like the style; a paragraph already in Heading 1 with nothing to clear is left alone.
assumptions: a paragraph qualifies when it has bold text and all its letters are capitals (typed or by the caps setting)
their own fonts, sizes, bold and spacing are cleared so the style applies; hidden text, list numbers, highlights and symbol fonts stay
targeted formatting is tracked (decision 14.1): Word shows 'Formatted: Heading 1'
